data.hypothesis: Combining T1's compact shared-memory source tiling with T3's reciprocal-square-root interaction factor and factor-four unrolling may improve the measured T1 program. Their individual valid measurements do not establish the combined candidate's correctness or speed.

memory_lessons.applicability: Do not add per-thread target coarsening to this initial combination; compare it separately if revisited.
memory_lessons.claim: T2's catalog reports a best measured time of 0.002554 s, slower than the 0.001844 s baseline, despite valid trials. This does not establish that every coarsening variant is slower.
memory_lessons.next_experiment: Keep the one-target-per-thread mapping while evaluating the T1/T3 combination.

data.notes: This combined candidate is unmeasured. T1 and T3 were individually reported valid and faster than baseline; the controller must freshly compile, check all correctness cases, and measure this combination. The launch configuration remains T1's 128-thread block, 128 items per block, and 2048 bytes of shared memory.
transformations: Retain T1's 128-thread CTA source tiling with a compact four-float source record and its matching 2048-byte shared-memory configuration.
Apply T3's factor-four unroll directive to the tiled source loop and its rsqrtf-based inverse-distance-cubed arithmetic.
Preserve the self-interaction skip, source traversal order, target-mass arithmetic, complete output state, and exact mass copy.
